arStrings.szText: Taking Direct Damage while you have {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} has a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%|]{/c} chance to either strike you for an additional {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life as Fire damage or {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c} you for {c_random}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100*Affix_Value_1|%2|]{/c} of your Maximum Life.

Taking Direct Damage while you have {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} has a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%|]{/c} chance to either strike you for an additional {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life as Fire damage or {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c} you for {c_random}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100*Affix_Value_1|%2|]{/c} of your Maximum Life.
